definitions.cosine_clean_corruption: c_dot_r / sqrt(c_squared_norm * r_squared_norm); null if either squared norm is zero
definitions.cosine_projected_clean_corruption: Pc_dot_Pr / sqrt(Pc_squared_norm * Pr_squared_norm); null if either squared norm is zero
definitions.cancellation_fraction: -2*c_dot_r/(c_squared_norm+r_squared_norm); null if denominator zero; negative values mean reinforcement
definitions.retention: projected squared norm / original squared norm; original recorded ratios retained
definitions.aggregation: arithmetic mean of finite per-probe values within each seed/window; equal-weight mean of all three seed summaries per method/window; no p-values or step-level replication
definitions.clipping: No cosine or ratio clipping; full-precision JSON floats preserved
definitions.interpretation: Fixed training-corruption residual, not conditionally zero-mean noise; no causal explanation of accuracy effects
